messages:
marta: hey y'all, first day! laptop and monitor arrived, but my USB headset is missing from the kit and when i plug my personal usb-c headset into the company dock the audio cuts out intermittently during calls. also i can't resolve internal hostnames like registry.redwood.internal from my laptop, any pointers?
it-lucy: welcome Marta :wave: sorry about the missing headset. can you confirm which headset model you expected and paste a quick snippet of the audio failure (time + what happened)? for DNS, what does `dig registry.redwood.internal` return from your machine?
marta: expected the Plantronics spare that was listed in the packing form. audio issue: in Zoom the mic/audio drops ~5-10s after joining, comes back if i unplug/replug the headset. logged time approx 10:03am. dig output: ";; connection timed out; no servers could be reached"
alan: hi Marta, that dig output looks like DNS not pushed by our split-horizon resolver for devices on the new-join VLAN. two separate things: (1) headset may be USB power/driver on the dock, (2) DNS for internal names. try plugging the headset directly into the laptop (bypass dock) and retest audio for 10-15 minutes.
marta: plugged direct into laptop -> no dropouts so far. plugged back through dock -> drop at 10:12am after joining a call.
it-lucy: thanks. sounds like the dock's USB controller is reneging on the audio device. i'll schedule a dock swap and also push a firmware patch to the dock's controller we rolled out last week. can you share dock serial?
marta: DCK-1144-77
packing-bot: package PKG-9682 delivered to 6th floor bench 3 at 09:08. items: MacBook Air, Dell 24, RD-DK4 dock. missing: Plantronics spare headset.
it-bot: ticket IT-7255 created: "Missing Plantronics headset + Dock audio dropouts" assigned to it-lucy. ETA on parts/shipping 1 business day.
alan: on the DNS side i can see your device hitting the edge DNS but the internal resolver chain isn't authoritative for the new-join VLAN due to a routing rule missing for that subnet. i've opened infra ticket INFRA-1902 and a PR to add the route: https://go/repo/infra/dns/changes/1902. rollout scheduled in 20m.
it-lucy: i'll swap the dock today if the firmware push doesn't help. Marta, while we wait can you run `scutil --dns` and paste the resolver section? also try `ping registry.redwood.internal` to see if it hits any IP.
marta: pasted scutil snippet: "resolver #2
  domain : redwood.internal
  nameserver[0] : 10.32.4.12
  flags : Request A records". ping shows "ping: cannot resolve registry.redwood.internal: Unknown host"
alan: thanks, logs align with the missing route. rolling the route now. once infra deploys, re-run dig.
it-bot: infra change INFRA-1902 deployed to production.
marta: re-ran dig -> "registry.redwood.internal. 60 IN A 10.10.20.5". ping now resolves and responds. great.
it-lucy: firmware push attempted on dock serial DCK-1144-77 and completed. please unplug and replug the dock and test audio via dock again.
marta: re-plugged and tested a 20m call -> audio stable, no dropouts. thanks! still waiting on the spare Plantronics but shipping note says it's being sent today.
packing-bot: spare Plantronics headset reserved and dispatched from IT locker -> ETA next business day.
it-lucy: awesome. i'm marking ticket IT-7255 for follow-up; closing once headset delivered. thanks for the clear debug steps, Marta.
marta: massive thanks everyone, all working now :tada: will ping if headset doesn't arrive tomorrow.
